'''Chumburung''' (Kyongborong, Nchimburu, Nchummuru) is a [[Guang language|Guang or Guan language]] spoken by 69,000 persons, mostly Chumburu by tribe and living in the Kingdom of [[Chumburung]] at both sides of the southwestern leg of [[Lake Volta]] in [[Ghana]].

3,000 of these speak the Yeji (Yedji) dialect, which is quite divergent: no closer to Chumburung proper than [[Kplang language|Kplang]] or [[Krache language|Krache]] are.{{Citation needed|date=February 2025}}
